caseNameFull: Hogan v. United States Lewis v. United States Tirado v. United States and Balsam v. United States

opinions.text: C. A. 11th Cir. Motions of petitioners in Nos. 04-9239, 04-9307, and 04-9331 for leave to proceed informa pauperis granted. Certiorari granted, judgments vacated, and cases remanded for further consideration in light of United States v. Booker, 543 U. S. 220 (2005).
